name: create_session_directory
description:
Creates a new directory in a session's filesystem. By default, parent directories are created recursively if they don't exist (similar to `mkdir -p`).

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/fs/mkdir --method POST. Fill placeholders from inputs.

cwd.description: The base directory for resolving relative paths. If not specified, paths are resolved from the sandbox home directory.

path.description: The path of the directory to create. Can be absolute or relative to the working directory.

recursive.description: If true, creates parent directories as needed (like `mkdir -p`). If false, fails if parent directories do not exist.

sessionId.description: The unique identifier of the session to create the directory in.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
